title: Root-fix the susi-gemi openrouter_ext provider test race
goal: The Linux full-workspace run of release/v0.21.54 (9d2fe3d00) failed susi-gemi openrouter_ext::inline_tests::provider_reflects_manager_doctor_state_and_formats_provider_name; alone it passed, in full lib runs it failed 1 in 3. Cause: doctor() and provider() each resolve the OpenRouter key and endpoint from the process environment and the config under HOME, and the test held no env lock, so a sibling test moving HOME between the two calls made them disagree; it also read the operator's real key store. The test now holds crate::engines::env_test_lock() with an isolated EnvGuard home and a fixed test key, and also asserts the no-key refusal. The three other defects found in the same run (child HOME isolation, the console-helper name guard, unused sync_hooks helpers) were fixed on main by T-MAINFIX-1 first, so this task carries only this one.
